summary: Confirmed $46.73 and full hookups; changed platform roverpass->phone (RoverPass listing not bookable, operator takes email/phone only). Added 50A, 42 overnight sites from the map, Apr 15-Oct 15 season, laundry, store, one-year window. Note cleaned ('140 gravel pull-thrus' and 'via RoverPass' gone).
flags: GATE: $46.73 plus tax on the operator's 2026 rates, under $50. GS Park: no (stored false, derived from the directory; the operator is silent). Nearest gateway: none within 40 km (Indianapolis 58 km). Family has not stayed. Presence: working website + phone 765-436-7190. Google 'Old Mill Run Campground' 4.5 from 280 reviews.

REVIEWS: the newest review, 2 months ago, reads: 'This is NOT your normal vacation RV campground! 90% of the sites are used by what looks like full time residents or seasonal residents! It's looks like a run down mobile home park! Sites have decks, sheds and stuff thrown around like it's not clean! Very unkept! Do not recommend at all!!!!' A year ago: 'Great place to stay. Lots of activities and secure grounds. A little more gravel at overnight pull throughs would be nice.' and 'The showers are spacious and clean'. A month ago: 'Very nice people. Would definitely stay here again'.

LONG-STAY: test 4 passes, narrowly in character. Colour-keyed map: 42 overnight RV sites + 6 primitive tent = 48 nightly; about 270 white seasonal sites by my count of the map (stored note said 280). About 1 in 7. Test 2 passes (posted nightly rate). Operator: 'We are currently on a wait list for Monthly and Seasonal Sites'; seasonal $2000. Imagery shows the seasonal rows built up and the overnight rows empty and tidy.

RIG AGE: 'Any camper/Rv/Trailer over 10 years of age must be approved by park staff before entering the park.' EKKO (2023) passes until 2033. 'All adults ... subject to a background check at any time'; 'Golf Carts are only allowed for seasonal campers'.

ROVERPASS: not claimed: API record has isBookable false, isRequest true, so the stored platform 'roverpass' and the note's 'Nightly via RoverPass' were wrong. The operator's 'Reserve your stay' button goes to its rates page and email/phone.

PIN: stored 40.1408,-86.6292 is at the office/entrance on the county road, about 360 m from the overnight rows. Correct to 40.1432,-86.6264 (centre of the overnight rows, read off the map against imagery).

WATER: stored 'pond' is a re-audit lead. Overnight rows run east from the east pond: the west end of the rows (sites 401, 412) is about 30 m from the shore across the park road; most overnight sites are 50-130 m away. The sites actually on a pond (445-462) are seasonal. Sugar Creek is about 100 m beyond the rows' east end, through trees (imagery estimates; Overpass not queried here).
